text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While passing by the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna bake the best desserts
ever! ♪
Thank you both so much for
agreeing to help!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ♪ I'll try my best to teach you

everything I know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
My repertoire is nothing to sneeze at.
Let's make
them big and buono! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!
choice_data_list: カフェテリアでお菓子作り？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we're gonna bake something for
you as
thanks for all the hard work you
do every day!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The chef gave us the okay to use the
cafeteria
once we told her our idea. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Once you eat my delicious cake, your
heart's
gonna—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
N-nothing! You can watch us bake if you
want! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Now we mix the granulated sugar in...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: La la la... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she's still new to baking,
Mayano Top
Gun seems to be having a
lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she's still new to baking,
Mayano Top
Gun seems to be having a
lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I offer a few words of encouragement as
I watch
her work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...But they're covered up by the sound of
my
rumbling stomach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ♪ Hold on a second. We're almost
done.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, we made some meringue cookies in
our free
time earlier. Would you like
one?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gratefully accept one of Nishino Flower
and
Hishi Akebono's cookies.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: R-really? I'm glad you like it.
choice_data_list: おいしい！好みの味だよ！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ("Yum"? "Just to my taste"? ...I want Trainer to say that to me! )

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (Looks like I've got no other choice...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Flower! Bono! I'm gonna make the cake
by myself!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Totally! No one knows what Trainer likes
more
than I do!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(If I'm gonna fly higher than the two of
them, I
have to make something
incredible!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's finished cake has
an...
indescribable structure and color.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will be to your taste! I made it
with your
favorite foods in mind!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And it's full of my love too... You'll eat
it, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I brace myself and take a bite of Mayano
Top
Gun's cake...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Is it really that good?! Is it actually to
your taste?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ♪ A successful landing!
choice_data_list: ああ、さすがマヤノだな！
うん、さすがマヤノだね！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My words of praise leave Mayano Top
Gun more
excited than I've ever seen
her. She's still in very
high spirits as we
finish our training afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell them that watching them bake
makes me
want to give it a go myself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you like to join us then? I can
give you
a few pointers if you need any!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait! Trainer, you're supposed to
be
watching me bake!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...
choice_data_list: 俺もマヤノにお礼がしたいんだ
私もマヤノにお礼がしたい

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Copy that! ☆ In that case, prepare for
bakeoff! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The more, the merrier. I'm sure the
sweets will
come out even more buono
now. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to bake a cake, but it's a bit
burnt...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wow! A cake from Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Gggh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda b-bitter, but grown-ups like
bitter
things, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No way!
choice_data_list: 焦げてるだけだ！食べなくていい！
焦げてるだけだよ！食べなくていいから！

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I won't let a single crumb of your
feelings go to
waste! I'm gonna eat it all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And that's why you're gonna try the cake
I made.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Say "aaah"! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! Can you taste all the gratitude I
put into
it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mission accomplished. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Th-they're so close... My heart is going
to beat
out of my chest if I keep
watching!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And they both live buono-ly ever
after! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the help of her two friends,
Mayano Top
Gun's baking is a total
success.
